parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists in the same `Wallpaper` package. The structural signal is that they share the same syntactic shape (a type alias declaration at roughly the same line number with no members), but `StitchableWallpaperView`, `SwiftUIWallpaperView`, `CompositeWallpaperView`, and `ThemeDebugControlsGenerator` are clearly distinct domain concepts — three are renderer view aliases and one is a debug-UI generator alias — whose coincidence is purely structural (all happen to be empty type aliases). No fields or methods are shared that could be lifted, and the names encode unrelated responsibilities. Merging or extracting these would conflate unrelated abstractions.
